title: Scheduled wakes of a person's conversations
description: Root: the reply of the agent socket's /agent/v1/wakes routes (open-habitat agent wake create|list|update|delete|due) and of POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/wake, the person's move or cancel. The agent asks to be woken at a time; the person's daemon keeps the wake in the person's own state directory and, at that time, starts the conversation's Pi if it has stopped and gives the agent a turn with the wake's note, whose reply rises to Sinun vuorosi like any reply. A wake that fires more than two minutes late carries late_seconds. Creating does not choose the conversation's rail section. At most 100 wakes are pending per person; creating more is refused with wake_limit_reached. A create that repeats an idempotency_key returns the stored wake with replayed true, or is refused with idempotency_conflict when its time or note differs. Archiving the conversation cancels its pending wakes (cancel_reason archived); the archive notice's undo restores them, and a later restore does not, in which case the agent is told of the cancellation with the person's next message.

wakes.description: wake list: the current conversation's wakes, any status, or with --all every pending wake of the person.

due.description: wake due: how many pending wakes were due; the daemon fires them after replying.

next_at.description: wake due: when the next pending wake that is not yet due is set; absent when none.

note.description: The agent's own note for the wake: what to do when woken. Shown to the person in the conversation, never on the rail row.

wake.description: One wake. at is when it fires, set_at when the agent set it, moved_from the time the agent set once the person moved it. status pending until it fires (fired, fired_at), is cancelled (cancel_reason agent, person or archived, cancelled_at) or fails after an hour of retries (failed).

pending.description: A pending wake as the snapshot shows it on the conversation.

request.description: The body of POST /agent/v1/wakes (agent wake create --current). at is RFC 3339 with an explicit offset or Z and must be in the future.

update.description: The body of PATCH /agent/v1/wakes/<id> (agent wake update): a new time, a new note, or both.

personRequest.description: The body of POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/wake: the person moves a pending wake to at (Muuta aikaa…) or cancels it (Peru herätys). The agent hears of a move in the wake message and of a cancel with the person's next message.
